words: A 5v5 tactical hero shooter set across nine shattered worlds. Master an agent, hold the rift, and climb the ladder. Free to play.
Precise gunplay. Wild abilities. One rift.
One-tap headshots, recoil you can learn and no random spread. Skill wins rounds.
Walls, smokes, teleports and scans. Combine them with your team to break any defence.
Ranked seasons, placement matches and a world final every year for the very best.
